svg.title: FeB2 spin stall and moment rotation

cc:Work.dc:title: FeB2 spin stall and moment rotation
cc:Work.dc:description: The spin residual reaches about 1e-4 by evaluation 60, then rises to about 2e-3 and stays there, well above the charge residual, while the net moment turns by about 29 degrees over 720 evaluations.
